info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector MeshServices API
Microsoft Azure Gets The Service Resource With The Given Name

params.name: api-version
params.description: The version of the API. This parameter is required and its value must be '6.4-preview'.

items.docs: Gets the information about the Service resource with the given name. The information include the description and other properties of the Service.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Lists All The Service Resources

params.name: api-version
params.description: The version of the API. This parameter is required and its value must be '6.4-preview'.

items.docs: Gets the information about all services of an application resource. The information include the description and other properties of the Service.
